Reviewed against the #4303 code. Member passkeys section: six endpoints and their single authority sources (local-account-passkeys.ts); preview off by default with the feature_preview_disabled refusal and descriptor withdrawal (local-account-provider.ts, local-account-runtime.ts); UV required; 15-minute freshness for adding; last-sign-in-method refusal; recovery sharing the single-use reset token and ending other sessions; disabled and signed-out-everywhere accounts covering passkey sessions, isVerifiedSessionCurrent and #3586 tokens. Origin section: RP ID is the STATION_AUTHENTICATION_ORIGIN hostname, the expected origin is exact, and approved non-auth origins get passkey_origin_unsupported. Contract bullet: the passkey-* operations and the two-step shape. Browser entry: passkey choices only for declared operations. Checked by local-account-passkeys.test.ts, the PAT production-composition test, AccountEntryView.test.tsx and member-passkeys-live.spec.ts. Not proven: real platform or synced authenticators (only a CDP virtual and a software authenticator), and the hostname-change behaviour, which is reasoned from WebAuthn RP ID binding and not executed.
